subject: maths
title: Continuous and Joint Distributions
welcome_lead: Move beyond discrete: pdfs, cdfs and joint distributions of two variables.
meta_desc: HL Maths adventure on continuous random variables, pdfs and joint distributions.
final_note: ∫ f(x) dx = 1 over the support of any valid pdf!

concepts.def: f(x) ≥ 0 with ∫ f(x) dx = 1 over support.
F(x) = P(X ≤ x) = ∫ from -∞ to x of f(t) dt.
E(X) = ∫ x f(x) dx for continuous X.
f(x,y) describes pairs X, Y; integrates to 1.
f_X(x) = ∫ f(x,y) dy over all y.

walkthroughs.body_html:
f(x,y) = 4xy on [0,1]^2. Find f_X(x).

f_X(x) = ∫_0^1 4xy dy = 2x. So X is f(x) = 2x.
